name: P-008 native actual uninstall/reinstall clears old pairing
summary: The maintained Mac VM simulator runner passed 60 native unit tests, 5 UI smoke tests and three separate reinstall phases, each with zero failures or skips. Visible pairing against an owned real operator was followed by an ordinary relaunch without a payload or credential seed, which retained authorized reads. Actual simctl uninstall removed the original app data container; reinstall created a different container. Two subsequent launches, without credential-wipe arguments, displayed pairing onboarding and no Operator UI. All 356 declared retained artifact hashes and byte sizes were verified locally, along with archive, result and reinstall receipts; screenshots were visually reviewed. This records an already-completed development simulator run and does not close the whole P-008 acceptance bar.
